course.title: Vector, Matrix and Ordinary Differential Equation

content.value: Set up the initial-value problem that will give the velocity of a 60 kg sky diver that jumps out of a plane with no initial velocity and an air resistance of 0.8|v|. for this example, assume that the positive direction is upward.
